summary: JD.com filed a Form 6-K (report of foreign private issuer) announcing that its board of directors will hold a meeting on May 12, 2026 to approve unaudited Q1 2026 results. The filing is a routine quarterly earnings notice, not a special situation. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or corporate action is described. The 6-K merely schedules a board meeting for results approval and provides conference call details. This is a standard periodic report with no special-situation content.
